newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein easier, trade slow.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein easier, trade slow.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were easier in late trading on Thursday, with sharp falls in Malaysia cooling buying interest, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,385-90 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but trades were also heard at 5-10 rupiah above and below the range. Crude palm oil was done at 1,174 and 1,175 rupiah/kg at a tender for two parcels in Medan on Wednesday.

"The market is weakening due to declines in Malaysia," one trader said. "Buyers showed little interest because they are anticipating further declines tomorrow." Traders said palm olein was expected to weaken five rupiah at the opening on Friday.
